passages.text:

questions.question: How long should a temporarily locked account be left before another sign-in attempt?

passages.text:
Support Handbook Note — Accounts

A temporarily locked account should be left for 15 minutes before another sign-in attempt. After repeated failed sign-in attempts, an account may be temporarily locked.

Technical Support Memo — Accounts

A temporarily locked account should be left for 15 minutes before another sign-in attempt. After repeated failed sign-in attempts, an account may be temporarily locked.
